page.title: Target
page.purpose: Explain one target completely: what was probed, what it proved, how it is reached, and precisely what is missing when it is unavailable.

priorities.statement: Every probed capability is listed with its result and the time it was probed.
priorities.notes: A stale probe presented as current is worse than no probe. Age is part of the answer.

priorities.statement: Transport is explicit — local host or a named bridge node.
priorities.notes: The operator must be able to tell where work will actually execute, because that changes what can fail.

priorities.statement: A remote target whose host node is offline says so, and is never omitted.
priorities.notes: A vanishing target reads as 'not mine' rather than 'temporarily unreachable'.

states.description: A fully available local emulator target.
Android SDK absent. Every dependent capability is unavailable and names the acquisition next action.
/dev/kvm absent or not writable. The target is unavailable rather than slow, because unaccelerated video evidence is unusable.
A remote target whose host node is offline, shown with that exact reason.

claims.statement: Every capability result displays when it was probed.
claims.rationale: S2A-P0-003. Capability is a measurement, and a measurement without a timestamp cannot be judged current.

claims.statement: A target whose host node is offline remains listed, carrying the offline reason.
claims.rationale: Omitting it would make a temporary reachability failure look like a configuration change.

claims.statement: A target without hardware acceleration reports unavailable and offers no option to run anyway.
claims.rationale: An unaccelerated emulator runs at 3–5 FPS; its video evidence cannot support a release claim, so offering the run would manufacture a worthless pass.
